description: A four step sequencer with three rows, each row quantised to the same root and scale and slewed to its own output

params.text: Sets the root note the three rows are quantised to, the twelve semitones from C to B
Chooses the scale the three rows are quantised to: seventeen scales and a last position that leaves the voltages unquantised
Halves the voltage of every step knob in one position and leaves it whole in the other
Sets the voltage of that step in that row, -5V to 5V before quantising
Sets how long that row takes to reach a new voltage, from 0.1 seconds to 102 seconds
Jumps the sequencer to that step

inputs.text: Above 0V the clock counts backwards through the steps
A rising edge moves the sequencer one step on, or one step back while the REV input is above 0V
A rising edge sends the sequencer to the first step
Chooses the step directly, the first at -5V and the last at 5V, in place of the clock
A rising edge jumps the sequencer to that step

outputs.text: That row's quantised and slewed voltage

inputs.0: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
